Upcoming price and levy changes
Bord Gáis Energy has announced changes to our residential electricity and gas prices, effective from 9 October 2026. There will also be changes to the PSO levy from the 1 October 2026.
The Public Service Obligation (PSO) levy is mandated by the Irish Government and approved by the European Commission. Due to recent electricity market stabilization and projected wholesale pricing, a significantly lower PSO payment will be required for 2026/2027.
There is an annual PSO levy of €6.67 including VAT (€6.12 excluding VAT) from 1 October 2026 to 30 September 2027.

Day-ahead prices
The dynamic tariff consists of three price components - standing charge, base unit rate (as shown above) and a dynamic unit rate. The dynamic unit rate changes every half hour. It’s linked to the day‑ahead electricity market, so prices can go up or down.
See Day-ahead prices.
There’s no Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) for this plan. That’s because day‑ahead market prices change every half hour, so there isn’t a fixed annual cost that can be accurately calculated upfront.
There’s also no discount applied to the unit rate. With the Smart Dynamic tariff, you’re already getting direct access to wholesale electricity prices.
Please note that this is a financially risky product as there is no certainty on the dynamic unit rate. Prices effective from 9 October.
There is an annual PSO levy of €6.67 including VAT (€6.12 excluding VAT) from 1 October 2026 to 30 September 2027.
Learn more about Smart Dynamic tariff
Microgeneration
If you generate surplus electricity, you can earn €0.185 credit per kWh. Subject to change. Payments are made
four times a year
and will be paid
as a credit on your electricity bill
. VAT on your microgeneration payment will be accounted for by Bord Gáis Energy. For more information visit our
Microgeneration page
or our
help section
.
Estimated Annual Bill (EAB)
The Commission for Regulation of Utilities (CRU) requires all electricity and gas suppliers to set out an “Estimated Annual Bill” figure for each of their offers. This figure indicates an estimated annual bill for that particular offer. It is based on CRU published average annual consumption figures and suppliers then apply their own price plans to calculate the EAB.
Click here to read more about EAB

EV plans vs smart electricity tariffs
EV plans vs smart electricity tariffs
Not all electricity plans are created equal.
Find out how EV plans compare to standard smart tariffs and which one suits your lifestyle best.
As electric vehicles (EVs) become more popular, energy providers are introducing specialised tariffs tailored to the unique needs of EV owners. But how do these EV plans compare to other tariffs? Let’s delve into the key differences and why they matter for your wallet and charging habits.
What are EV plans?
ℹ️EV plans are home energy plans designed to offer cheaper electricity rates during specific off-peak hours, particularly overnight, when most EV owners charge their vehicles.
These plans often include additional perks, such as ultra-low rates during designated “EV hours” and greater flexibility for energy-conscious consumers.
EV plans and smart electricity tariffs: a detailed comparison
Choosing the right energy plan depends on your charging habits and overall electricity usage. The table below compares three types of electricity plans:
Smart EV plan
– Offers ultra-low rates during dedicated EV charging hours (2am - 5am).
Standard Smart tariff
– Different unit rates based on the time of day.
Smart All Day plan
– A flat rate for electricity, regardless of when you use it.

Key takeaways from the comparison
1. Ultra-low EV rates 🔋
The standout feature of the EV plan is the ultra-low rate of 8.98 cent per kWh during “Urban EV Units” hours (2am to 5am). This is significantly cheaper than the 24.28 cent per kWh rate for “Urban Night Units” under a standard smart tariff and the 30.78 cent per kWh of the Smart All Day plan.
If you can schedule your EV charging during these hours, the savings add up quickly.
2.
Standing charge variations 💳
The annual standing charge for the EV plan is €364.89, which is €120.13 more than the €244.76 for both the standard smart tariff and the Smart All-Day plan.
Consider if the savings from the discounted EV charging rates justify the higher standing charge, especially if you are a frequent EV charger.
3. Day and peak rate considerations ☀️
For general electricity usage, the Smart All Day plan provides a consistent flat rate of 30.78c per kWh, simplifying budgeting.
The Standard Smart Tariff provides the cheapest day and peak rates of the variable rate plans.
The EV plan offers a rate between the other two plans during the day, but the highest peak rate.
4. Simplicity vs potential savings 💶
The Smart All Day plan offers simplicity and predictable cost.
The EV plan offers the potential for the greatest savings for EV owners who can charge during the designated hours.
The standard smart tariff offers savings for those who can shift their usage to off peak times, but do not own an EV.

Final thoughts on EV plans
Understanding the differences between EV plans and other tariffs is essential for making an informed choice. With the right plan, you can not only reduce your energy costs but also contribute to a more sustainable energy future. Evaluate your usage habits and charging schedule to decide which option is best for you.

Price change information
Price change information
Helping you understand the latest price changes
Here's where you'll find a breakdown of what’s changing, why it's happening, and where you can find support and information if you need it. We’re committed to being clear and transparent.
Overview
What’s changing and when?
Check your changes
Why are energy prices increasing?
Frequently asked questions
Are you on the right plan?
Energy saving tips
Concerns about payment
What’s changing and when?
From
9 October 2026
, Bord Gáis Energy will increase:
Electricity
Electricity unit rates by 9.1%.
Electricity standing charges by 7.2%.
An average electricity bill will increase by 8.8%, an estimated €14.75 monthly*.
Gas
Gas unit rates by 10.6%.
Gas standing charges by 7%.
An average gas bill will increase by 9.3% an estimated €11.67 monthly*.
This is Bord Gáis Energy’s first gas price increase in four years, and we continue to offer the lowest gas standing charge in the market.
Important information for contract customers
If you're receiving a contract discount, that percentage won't change for the duration of your contract but the price will increase by the amounts shown. As a result of this price change, you have the right to terminate your contract within the next 30 days (from 9 September 2026). Your contract will continue if we don't hear from you within this period.‌
Check your changes
Increases in gas and electricity unit rates and standing charges will result in a typical residential electricity customer’s bill increasing by 8.8% or €14.75 per month and the typical residential gas customer’s bill increasing by 9.3% or €11.67 per month*. A typical dual fuel household bill will increase by 9.1% or €26.42 per month* .
*These figures are based on a typical annual consumption of 4,200 kWh for electricity and 11,000 kWh for gas (as defined by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities) and Bord Gáis Energy’s standard Urban 24-hour electricity tariff and standard gas tariff.
To see exactly how these changes will affect your costs, visit our Tariffs page. Choose your electricity and gas tariffs and discounts in the dropdown menus to see your new Estimated Annual Bill**.
**The Estimated Annual Bill is calculated based on annual average consumption value of 4200 kWh in electricity and 11,000 kWh in gas and your price plan with any applicable discounts.
Tariff information
Why are energy prices increasing?
There are several factors driving this change:
Continued increases in
network charges
Ongoing volatility in
wholesale energy markets
, including higher wholesale gas costs
Broader
inflationary pressures
and the rising cost of supplying energy
While we've worked hard to absorb costs in the past, including absorbing network charges in 2024 and passing on two price reductions over the last four years, sustained increases in the cost of supplying energy mean we now need to adjust prices to reflect current market conditions.
Frequently asked questions about pricing changes
This section covers the most common queries about upcoming changes to pricing.
Why is Bord Gáis Energy increasing prices?
Higher network charges, continued volatility in wholesale energy markets and broader inflationary pressures are driving increased energy prices.
Bord Gáis Energy has announced a price increase for residential electricity and gas customers, effective from 9 October 2026. The changes are in response to sustained increases in the cost of supplying energy including higher network charges, continued volatility in wholesale energy markets and broader inflationary pressures.
Increases in gas and electricity unit rates and standing charges will result in a typical residential electricity customer’s bill increasing by 8.8%, or €14.75 per month* and the typical residential gas customer’s bill increasing by 9.3%, or €11.67 per month*. A typical dual fuel household bill will increase by 9.1%, or €26.42 per month^.
Click here to view the updated unit rates and tariffs
. If you're receiving a contract discount, that percentage won't change for the duration of your contract.
Bord Gáis Energy has a range of advice services and supports in place to help customers. If you've concerns about paying your energy bill, see our FAQ
Support with paying bills
.
*These figures are based on a typical annual consumption of 4,200 kWh for electricity and 11,000 kWh for gas (as defined by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities) and Bord Gáis Energy’s standard Urban 24-hour electricity tariff and standard gas tariff.
^The PSO levy is to reduce to €0.51 (excl. VAT) per month from 1 October 2026. This has been reflected in the above calculations for electricity bills.
How much are prices increasing by?
A typical dual fuel household bill will increase by 9.1%, or €26.42 per month.
Unit rates for electricity will increase by 9.1% while the standing charges will rise by 7.2%, from 9 October 2026. This will increase a typical bill for Bord Gáis Energy electricity customers by 8.8%, an average of €14.75 per month*.
Unit rates for gas will increase by 10.6% while the standing charges will increase by 7%, from 9 October 2026. This will increase a typical bill for Bord Gáis Energy gas customers by 9.3%, an average of €11.67 per month*.
For the Smart Dynamic tariff, the base unit rate will increase by 13.7% while the standing charge will increase by 4.7%, from 9 October 2026.
Click here to view the updated unit rates and tariffs
. If you're receiving a contract discount, that percentage won't change for the duration of your contract. To see your unit rate with your discount included, use the dropdown above the unit rate cards.
If you've concerns about paying your energy bill, see our FAQ
Support with paying bills
.
*These figures are based on a typical annual consumption of 4,200 kWh for electricity and 11,000 kWh for gas (as defined by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities) and Bord Gáis Energy’s standard Urban 24-hour electricity tariff and standard gas tariff.
When is the price increase effective?
The increase to electricity and gas prices is effective from 9 October 2026.
The increase to unit rates and standing charges is effective from 9 October 2026.
Click here to view the updated unit rates and tariffs
. If you're receiving a contract discount, that percentage won't change for the duration of your contract.
Bord Gáis Energy has a range of advice services and supports in place to help customers. If you've concerns about paying your energy bill, see our FAQ
Support with paying bills
.
I'm a Pay As You Go customer, does the price change affect me?
Yes, Pay As You Go customers will be affected by the price change.
The new Pay As You Go (PAYG) rates will apply from 9 October 2026.
Click here for full details on the updated rates.
Electricity PAYG customers
When you buy credit, your receipt will include a 60-digit Power Code instead of the usual 20 digits. Please enter the full 60-digit code into your meter to update your electricity rate.
If you see a rejection message, such as 'Rejected Wrong Tar', please contact us on 01 611 01 01.
Smart PAYG customers don’t need to do anything – just top up as normal. The price change will be applied automatically from 9 October.
Gas PAYG customers
You don't need to do anything. The price change will be applied automatically the next time you top up your meter. The price change won't take effect on your meter until 9 October.
If you've concerns about paying your energy bill, see our FAQ
Support with paying bills
.
How will the price change be shown on my bill?
Bills will be split between consumption up to 8 October 2026 at the previous rates and consumption from 9 October 2026 at the new rates.
Your bill covers energy used before and after the price change on
9 October 2026
. That’s why you’ll see two date ranges:
Before the change
– This shows your usage and charges at the old rates (up to
8 October 2026
).
After the change
– This shows your usage and charges at the new rates (from
9
October 2026
).
If your bill is more than one page, these details might appear across both the first and second pages.
Click here to view the updated unit rates and tariffs
. If you're receiving a contract discount, that percentage won't change for the duration of your contract. To see your unit rate with your discount included, use the dropdown above the unit rate cards.
If you've concerns about paying your energy bill, see our FAQ
Support with paying bills
.
Are you on the right plan?
Your energy needs may have changed. Whether you're working from home, using more electricity in winter, or just want to reduce your costs, we can help you find a plan that suits your lifestyle.
Check out our smart home products and services
Review your energy usage in your online account
Explore smart plan design around they way you live
Find a plan
Energy saving tips
We’ve lots of practical tips to help you reduce your energy usage and lower your bills.
General energy-saving advice for your home
Smart product recommendations
Home upgrade ideas
Learn more
Concerns about paying your bill?
We understand these are uncertain times. If you're struggling, please reach out. We’ll work with you to find a solution that suits your needs.
Moving to
Level Pay
(spread your payments evenly over 12 months)
Setting up
scheduled payments
(a recurring payment on a weekly or monthly basis, in addition to your existing payment method)
Installing a
Pay As You Go
meter
Setting up a
payment plan
We offer a
Special Services Register
for gas and electricity customers who are particularly vulnerable to disconnection during the winter months, such as customers who have a disability, or those who are over 66 and living alone. If you wish to register for special services, please fill out our
online form
.
We also offer a
Priority Services Register
for electricity customers who are critically dependent on electrically-powered equipment, which may include life-protecting devices, assistive technologies, to support independent living and medical equipment. If you wish to register for priority services, please fill out our
online form
.
Customers can also contact the Money Advice and Budgeting Service (MABS), who provide information and assist customers with putting budget plans in place. MABS is a national, free, independent, confidential, and non-judgemental service for people in debt or at risk of getting into debt and it is funded by the Department of Social Protection.
View their website
for further information.
If you receive Social Welfare payments, you can spread the cost of your energy bills by paying regular amounts towards your bills. The money is then deducted from your weekly Social Welfare payment. You can avail of this through An Post’s
Household Budget Scheme
.
Certain social welfare and state pension recipients may also be entitled to the government's
Fuel Allowance
. A Fuel Allowance is a means-tested payment to help with the cost of heating your home during the winter months. You can get the Fuel Allowance if you're getting a long-term social welfare payment and are unable to provide for your heating needs from your own resources. The Fuel Allowance season normally begins in late September of each year and ends in April. See
gov.ie
for more information.
Common questions about payment
Visit our
Help section
or check out our most popular FAQs below.

Hive EV Charger Installation and Smart EV Plan Bundle with €150 Bonus Credit - T&Cs January 2026
New and existing Bord Gais Energy residential customers are eligible for the bonus credit of €150, who have had a Hive EV Charger installed through Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and successfully sign-up to our Smart EV Plan. This offer applies to Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes customers that have paid a deposit on a Hive EV Charger on or between 27/01/2026 and 30/09/2027. Customers must first install and pay for a Hive EV Charger from Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes, before switching to the Bord Gais Energy Smart EV Plan. The bonus will be applied as a credit to the customer’s electricity account, and the address of the electricity account must match the address where the charger was installed via Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes. €150 credit will be applied to customer’s electricity account after a successful registration to a Bord Gáis Energy EV Smart plan within 6 months of paying the final balance for your Hive EV Charger on Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and any applicable cooling-off period has passed. If you meet the criteria set out in clause 1), the Bill Credit will be applied to your Energy account within two months of signing up to a Smart EV Plan. Once the credit has been applied to your account, it will appear on your next bill. If you are billed prior to your credit being applied or your credit is applied before your direct debit payment is taken (14 days), your Direct Debit payment will be processed, and the credit will then come off your next bill. If Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes are unable to match you with a local tradesperson in your area to install the Hive EV Charger, you will not be eligible for the Bill Credit or any other compensation. Customers cannot exchange their bill credit for cash. Bord Gais Energy may change or withdraw the terms and conditions of this offer at any time.

Below Terms and Conditions are valid for all Smart Dual Fuel and Smart electricity only offers
Please note that if you are an existing Bord Gáis Energy customer and move to a smart tariff, it’s not possible to revert back to a non-smart tariff/ old meter type due to industry rules for smart metering.
If you're an existing customer on Level Pay and sign up to a Smart plan your level pay will stop. Any balance due will be taken with your next Direct Debit. Any credit will also be taken into account.
Standard Smart (SST) Tariff Terms and Conditions
Free Saturday or Free Sunday Tariff Tariff Terms and Conditions
Smart EV (Electric Vehicle) Tariff Terms and Conditions
STOD Weekender Tariff Terms and Conditions
Smart All Day Terms and Conditions
Smart Standard Plus Tariff Terms and Conditions
With 12 months Fixed Term contract:
For dual fuel offers - discounts are off our gas and smart electricity unit rates for 12 months. 5% discount thereafter. You must pay by direct debit and paperless billing to continue to receive these discounts.
For electricity only offers - discounts are off our smart electricity unit rates for 12 months. 5% discount thereafter. You must pay by direct debit and paperless billing to continue to receive these discounts.
An early exit fee of €50 will apply if you leave before the end of your Fixed Term Contract.
Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026, gas prices are valid from 1 May 2025 and are subject to change.
If you’re signing up for an offer with Hive Active Heating Thermostat, please check these additional
terms and conditions.
Our plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity and 10% gas will be supplied from renewable sources.
All EV (electric vehicle) offers are not limited to customers who drive an electric vehicle. Please visit our
Electric Vehicle page
.
Terms and Conditions of supply
. If you want a plan without Direct Debit payment and Paperless billing then please call us on
01 6110151
* All of our electricity plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity, and backed by EU Guarantee of Origin (GO) certificates. For every unit of electricity you use, an equivalent amount of renewable electricity is produced and recorded through the GO system. Subject to verification by the CRU under the CRU’s Green Source Product Verification process.
***Annual savings - for new customers only
.
New customers only. Electricity Smart Meter required. 12 month Dual Fuel Contract. 17% discount off all standard electricity unit rates (exc. Smart Free Time and Smart EV) and 17% off gas standard unit rates for 12 months. You must choose Paperless bills and Direct Debit. Annual Saving of €506 is compared to our Smart All Day Tariff and Gas Standard Tariff (no discount) and annual consumption of 4200 kWh (electricity) and 11,000 kWh (gas). Early exit fee of €50. Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026, gas prices are valid from 1 May 2025 and are subject to change. See bordgaisenergy.ie for prices, ts and cs and all EABs*
Terms and Conditions of supply
** Estimated Annual Bill
The Estimated Annual Bill is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 4200 kWh in electricity (as defined by the CRU) and Bord Gáis Energy’s Standard Smart Tariff (Urban) less any percentage discounts. Your actual rates may differ depending on your meter type. Consumption is split as follows (as defined by the CRU):- Day – 52% Night – 39%, Peak – 9%. Free offers such as boiler services (where applicable) are NOT included. The EAB is only shown on our Standard Smart Tariff. Please refer to
Our Tariffs & Prices
page for information on EAB and current rates.
Terms & Conditions
Microgen export option is available on plans for qualifying customers who have solar panels installed and have been certified by ESB Networks. Subject to approval.
Variable prices are effective 2 November 2025 and are subject to change. Projected earnings are based on selling electricity to the grid only and don’t include savings from using less electricity. They’re calculated using CRU’s deemed export formula and will vary by your export type, system size, technology, and electricity use.
Microgen Export Plan
terms and conditions apply
.
Hive EV Charger Installation and Smart EV Plan Bundle with €150 Bonus Credit - T&Cs January 2026
New and existing Bord Gais Energy residential customers are eligible for the bonus credit of €150, who have had a Hive EV Charger installed through Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and successfully sign-up to our Smart EV Plan. This offer applies to Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes customers that have paid a deposit on a Hive EV Charger on or between 27/01/2026 and 30/09/2027. Customers must first install and pay for a Hive EV Charger from Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes, before switching to the Bord Gais Energy Smart EV Plan. The bonus will be applied as a credit to the customer’s electricity account, and the address of the electricity account must match the address where the charger was installed via Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes. €150 credit will be applied to customer’s electricity account after a successful registration to a Bord Gáis Energy EV Smart plan within 6 months of paying the final balance for your Hive EV Charger on Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and any applicable cooling-off period has passed. If you meet the criteria set out in clause 1), the Bill Credit will be applied to your Energy account within two months of signing up to a Smart EV Plan. Once the credit has been applied to your account, it will appear on your next bill. If you are billed prior to your credit being applied or your credit is applied before your direct debit payment is taken (14 days), your Direct Debit payment will be processed, and the credit will then come off your next bill. If Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes are unable to match you with a local tradesperson in your area to install the Hive EV Charger, you will not be eligible for the Bill Credit or any other compensation. Customers cannot exchange their bill credit for cash. Bord Gais Energy may change or withdraw the terms and conditions of this offer at any time.

Hive EV Charger Installation and Smart EV Plan Bundle with €150 Bonus Credit - T&Cs January 2026
New and existing Bord Gais Energy residential customers are eligible for the bonus credit of €150, who have had a Hive EV Charger installed through Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and successfully sign-up to our Smart EV Plan. This offer applies to Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes customers that have paid a deposit on a Hive EV Charger on or between 27/01/2026 and 30/09/2027. Customers must first install and pay for a Hive EV Charger from Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes, before switching to the Bord Gais Energy Smart EV Plan. The bonus will be applied as a credit to the customer’s electricity account, and the address of the electricity account must match the address where the charger was installed via Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes. €150 credit will be applied to customer’s electricity account after a successful registration to a Bord Gáis Energy EV Smart plan within 6 months of paying the final balance for your Hive EV Charger on Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and any applicable cooling-off period has passed. If you meet the criteria set out in clause 1), the Bill Credit will be applied to your Energy account within two months of signing up to a Smart EV Plan. Once the credit has been applied to your account, it will appear on your next bill. If you are billed prior to your credit being applied or your credit is applied before your direct debit payment is taken (14 days), your Direct Debit payment will be processed, and the credit will then come off your next bill. If Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes are unable to match you with a local tradesperson in your area to install the Hive EV Charger, you will not be eligible for the Bill Credit or any other compensation. Customers cannot exchange their bill credit for cash. Bord Gais Energy may change or withdraw the terms and conditions of this offer at any time.

We reward customer loyalty
Trusted provider of over 715,000 households
Below Terms and Conditions are valid for all Smart Dual Fuel and Smart electricity only offers
Please note that if you are an existing Bord Gáis Energy customer and move to a smart tariff, it’s not possible to revert back to a non-smart tariff/ old meter type due to industry rules for smart metering.
If you're an existing customer on Level Pay and sign up to a Smart plan your level pay will stop. Any balance due will be taken with your next Direct Debit. Any credit will also be taken into account.
Standard Smart (SST) Tariff Terms and Conditions
Free Saturday or Free Sunday Tariff Tariff Terms and Conditions
Smart EV (Electric Vehicle) Tariff Terms and Conditions
STOD Weekender Tariff Terms and Conditions
Smart All Day Terms and Conditions
Smart Standard Plus Tariff Terms and Conditions
With 12 months Fixed Term contract:
For dual fuel offers - discounts are off our gas and smart electricity unit rates for 12 months. 5% discount thereafter. You must pay by direct debit and paperless billing to continue to receive these discounts.
For electricity only offers - discounts are off our smart electricity unit rates for 12 months. 5% discount thereafter. You must pay by direct debit and paperless billing to continue to receive these discounts.
An early exit fee of €50 will apply if you leave before the end of your Fixed Term Contract.
Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026, gas prices are valid from 1 May 2025 and are subject to change.
If you’re signing up for an offer with Hive Active Heating Thermostat, please check these additional
terms and conditions.
Our plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity and 10% gas will be supplied from renewable sources.
All EV (electric vehicle) offers are not limited to customers who drive an electric vehicle. Please visit our
Electric Vehicle page
.
Terms and Conditions of supply
. If you want a plan without Direct Debit payment and Paperless billing then please call us on
01 6110151
* All of our electricity plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity, and backed by EU Guarantee of Origin (GO) certificates. For every unit of electricity you use, an equivalent amount of renewable electricity is produced and recorded through the GO system. Subject to verification by the CRU under the CRU’s Green Source Product Verification process.
***Annual savings - for new customers only
.
New customers only. Electricity Smart Meter required. 12 month Dual Fuel Contract. 17% discount off all standard electricity unit rates (exc. Smart Free Time and Smart EV) and 17% off gas standard unit rates for 12 months. You must choose Paperless bills and Direct Debit. Annual Saving of €506 is compared to our Smart All Day Tariff and Gas Standard Tariff (no discount) and annual consumption of 4200 kWh (electricity) and 11,000 kWh (gas). Early exit fee of €50. Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026, gas prices are valid from 1 May 2025 and are subject to change. See bordgaisenergy.ie for prices, ts and cs and all EABs*
Terms and Conditions of supply
** Estimated Annual Bill
The Estimated Annual Bill is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 4200 kWh in electricity (as defined by the CRU) and Bord Gáis Energy’s Standard Smart Tariff (Urban) less any percentage discounts. Your actual rates may differ depending on your meter type. Consumption is split as follows (as defined by the CRU):- Day – 52% Night – 39%, Peak – 9%. Free offers such as boiler services (where applicable) are NOT included. The EAB is only shown on our Standard Smart Tariff. Please refer to
Our Tariffs & Prices
page for information on EAB and current rates.
Terms & Conditions
Microgen export option is available on plans for qualifying customers who have solar panels installed and have been certified by ESB Networks. Subject to approval.
Variable prices are effective 2 November 2025 and are subject to change. Projected earnings are based on selling electricity to the grid only and don’t include savings from using less electricity. They’re calculated using CRU’s deemed export formula and will vary by your export type, system size, technology, and electricity use.

terms and conditions apply

Hive EV Charger Installation and Smart EV Plan Bundle with €150 Bonus Credit - T&Cs January 2026
New and existing Bord Gais Energy residential customers are eligible for the bonus credit of €150, who have had a Hive EV Charger installed through Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and successfully sign-up to our Smart EV Plan. This offer applies to Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes customers that have paid a deposit on a Hive EV Charger on or between 27/01/2026 and 30/09/2027. Customers must first install and pay for a Hive EV Charger from Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes, before switching to the Bord Gais Energy Smart EV Plan. The bonus will be applied as a credit to the customer’s electricity account, and the address of the electricity account must match the address where the charger was installed via Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes. €150 credit will be applied to customer’s electricity account after a successful registration to a Bord Gáis Energy EV Smart plan within 6 months of paying the final balance for your Hive EV Charger on Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and any applicable cooling-off period has passed. If you meet the criteria set out in clause 1), the Bill Credit will be applied to your Energy account within two months of signing up to a Smart EV Plan. Once the credit has been applied to your account, it will appear on your next bill. If you are billed prior to your credit being applied or your credit is applied before your direct debit payment is taken (14 days), your Direct Debit payment will be processed, and the credit will then come off your next bill. If Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes are unable to match you with a local tradesperson in your area to install the Hive EV Charger, you will not be eligible for the Bill Credit or any other compensation. Customers cannot exchange their bill credit for cash. Bord Gais Energy may change or withdraw the terms and conditions of this offer at any time.

Below Terms and Conditions are valid for all Smart Dual Fuel and Smart electricity only offers
Please note that if you are an existing Bord Gáis Energy customer and move to a smart tariff, it’s not possible to revert back to a non-smart tariff/ old meter type due to industry rules for smart metering.
If you're an existing customer on Level Pay and sign up to a Smart plan your level pay will stop. Any balance due will be taken with your next Direct Debit. Any credit will also be taken into account.

Free Saturday or Free Sunday Tariff Tariff Terms and Conditions

STOD Weekender Tariff Terms and Conditions

Smart Standard Plus Tariff Terms and Conditions
With 12 months Fixed Term contract:
For dual fuel offers - discounts are off our gas and smart electricity unit rates for 12 months. 5% discount thereafter. You must pay by direct debit and paperless billing to continue to receive these discounts.
For electricity only offers - discounts are off our smart electricity unit rates for 12 months. 5% discount thereafter. You must pay by direct debit and paperless billing to continue to receive these discounts.
An early exit fee of €50 will apply if you leave before the end of your Fixed Term Contract.
Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026, gas prices are valid from 1 May 2025 and are subject to change.
If you’re signing up for an offer with Hive Active Heating Thermostat, please check these additional
terms and conditions.
Our plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity and 10% gas will be supplied from renewable sources.
All EV (electric vehicle) offers are not limited to customers who drive an electric vehicle. Please visit our
Electric Vehicle page
.

. If you want a plan without Direct Debit payment and Paperless billing then please call us on

* All of our electricity plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity, and backed by EU Guarantee of Origin (GO) certificates. For every unit of electricity you use, an equivalent amount of renewable electricity is produced and recorded through the GO system. Subject to verification by the CRU under the CRU’s Green Source Product Verification process.
***Annual savings - for new customers only
.
New customers only. Electricity Smart Meter required. 12 month Dual Fuel Contract. 17% discount off all standard electricity unit rates (exc. Smart Free Time and Smart EV) and 17% off gas standard unit rates for 12 months. You must choose Paperless bills and Direct Debit. Annual Saving of €506 is compared to our Smart All Day Tariff and Gas Standard Tariff (no discount) and annual consumption of 4200 kWh (electricity) and 11,000 kWh (gas). Early exit fee of €50. Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026, gas prices are valid from 1 May 2025 and are subject to change. See bordgaisenergy.ie for prices, ts and cs and all EABs*
Terms and Conditions of supply
** Estimated Annual Bill
The Estimated Annual Bill is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 4200 kWh in electricity (as defined by the CRU) and Bord Gáis Energy’s Standard Smart Tariff (Urban) less any percentage discounts. Your actual rates may differ depending on your meter type. Consumption is split as follows (as defined by the CRU):- Day – 52% Night – 39%, Peak – 9%. Free offers such as boiler services (where applicable) are NOT included. The EAB is only shown on our Standard Smart Tariff. Please refer to
Our Tariffs & Prices
page for information on EAB and current rates.
Terms & Conditions

Variable prices are effective 2 November 2025 and are subject to change. Projected earnings are based on selling electricity to the grid only and don’t include savings from using less electricity. They’re calculated using CRU’s deemed export formula and will vary by your export type, system size, technology, and electricity use.

Hive EV Charger Installation and Smart EV Plan Bundle with €150 Bonus Credit - T&Cs January 2026
New and existing Bord Gais Energy residential customers are eligible for the bonus credit of €150, who have had a Hive EV Charger installed through Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and successfully sign-up to our Smart EV Plan. This offer applies to Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes customers that have paid a deposit on a Hive EV Charger on or between 27/01/2026 and 30/09/2027. Customers must first install and pay for a Hive EV Charger from Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes, before switching to the Bord Gais Energy Smart EV Plan. The bonus will be applied as a credit to the customer’s electricity account, and the address of the electricity account must match the address where the charger was installed via Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes. €150 credit will be applied to customer’s electricity account after a successful registration to a Bord Gáis Energy EV Smart plan within 6 months of paying the final balance for your Hive EV Charger on Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and any applicable cooling-off period has passed. If you meet the criteria set out in clause 1), the Bill Credit will be applied to your Energy account within two months of signing up to a Smart EV Plan. Once the credit has been applied to your account, it will appear on your next bill. If you are billed prior to your credit being applied or your credit is applied before your direct debit payment is taken (14 days), your Direct Debit payment will be processed, and the credit will then come off your next bill. If Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes are unable to match you with a local tradesperson in your area to install the Hive EV Charger, you will not be eligible for the Bill Credit or any other compensation. Customers cannot exchange their bill credit for cash. Bord Gais Energy may change or withdraw the terms and conditions of this offer at any time.

Below Terms and Conditions are valid for all Smart Dual Fuel and Smart electricity only offers
Please note that if you are an existing Bord Gáis Energy customer and move to a smart tariff, it’s not possible to revert back to a non-smart tariff/ old meter type due to industry rules for smart metering.
If you're an existing customer on Level Pay and sign up to a Smart plan your level pay will stop. Any balance due will be taken with your next Direct Debit. Any credit will also be taken into account.

Smart Standard Plus Tariff Terms and Conditions
With 12 months Fixed Term contract:
For dual fuel offers - discounts are off our gas and smart electricity unit rates for 12 months. 5% discount thereafter. You must pay by direct debit and paperless billing to continue to receive these discounts.
For electricity only offers - discounts are off our smart electricity unit rates for 12 months. 5% discount thereafter. You must pay by direct debit and paperless billing to continue to receive these discounts.
An early exit fee of €50 will apply if you leave before the end of your Fixed Term Contract.
Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026, gas prices are valid from 1 May 2025 and are subject to change.
If you’re signing up for an offer with Hive Active Heating Thermostat, please check these additional
terms and conditions.
Our plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity and 10% gas will be supplied from renewable sources.
All EV (electric vehicle) offers are not limited to customers who drive an electric vehicle. Please visit our
Electric Vehicle page
.
Terms and Conditions of supply
. If you want a plan without Direct Debit payment and Paperless billing then please call us on
01 6110151
* All of our electricity plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity, and backed by EU Guarantee of Origin (GO) certificates. For every unit of electricity you use, an equivalent amount of renewable electricity is produced and recorded through the GO system. Subject to verification by the CRU under the CRU’s Green Source Product Verification process.
***Annual savings - for new customers only
.
New customers only. Electricity Smart Meter required. 12 month Dual Fuel Contract. 17% discount off all standard electricity unit rates (exc. Smart Free Time and Smart EV) and 17% off gas standard unit rates for 12 months. You must choose Paperless bills and Direct Debit. Annual Saving of €506 is compared to our Smart All Day Tariff and Gas Standard Tariff (no discount) and annual consumption of 4200 kWh (electricity) and 11,000 kWh (gas). Early exit fee of €50. Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026, gas prices are valid from 1 May 2025 and are subject to change. See bordgaisenergy.ie for prices, ts and cs and all EABs*
Terms and Conditions of supply
** Estimated Annual Bill
The Estimated Annual Bill is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 4200 kWh in electricity (as defined by the CRU) and Bord Gáis Energy’s Standard Smart Tariff (Urban) less any percentage discounts. Your actual rates may differ depending on your meter type. Consumption is split as follows (as defined by the CRU):- Day – 52% Night – 39%, Peak – 9%. Free offers such as boiler services (where applicable) are NOT included. The EAB is only shown on our Standard Smart Tariff. Please refer to
Our Tariffs & Prices
page for information on EAB and current rates.
Terms & Conditions
Microgen export option is available on plans for qualifying customers who have solar panels installed and have been certified by ESB Networks. Subject to approval.
Variable prices are effective 2 November 2025 and are subject to change. Projected earnings are based on selling electricity to the grid only and don’t include savings from using less electricity. They’re calculated using CRU’s deemed export formula and will vary by your export type, system size, technology, and electricity use.
Microgen Export Plan
terms and conditions apply
.
Hive EV Charger Installation and Smart EV Plan Bundle with €150 Bonus Credit - T&Cs January 2026
New and existing Bord Gais Energy residential customers are eligible for the bonus credit of €150, who have had a Hive EV Charger installed through Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and successfully sign-up to our Smart EV Plan. This offer applies to Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes customers that have paid a deposit on a Hive EV Charger on or between 27/01/2026 and 30/09/2027. Customers must first install and pay for a Hive EV Charger from Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes, before switching to the Bord Gais Energy Smart EV Plan. The bonus will be applied as a credit to the customer’s electricity account, and the address of the electricity account must match the address where the charger was installed via Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes. €150 credit will be applied to customer’s electricity account after a successful registration to a Bord Gáis Energy EV Smart plan within 6 months of paying the final balance for your Hive EV Charger on Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes and any applicable cooling-off period has passed. If you meet the criteria set out in clause 1), the Bill Credit will be applied to your Energy account within two months of signing up to a Smart EV Plan. Once the credit has been applied to your account, it will appear on your next bill. If you are billed prior to your credit being applied or your credit is applied before your direct debit payment is taken (14 days), your Direct Debit payment will be processed, and the credit will then come off your next bill. If Bord Gais Energy Local Heroes are unable to match you with a local tradesperson in your area to install the Hive EV Charger, you will not be eligible for the Bill Credit or any other compensation. Customers cannot exchange their bill credit for cash. Bord Gais Energy may change or withdraw the terms and conditions of this offer at any time.

Smart Dynamic
Smart Dynamic
What is the Smart Dynamic tariff?
Smart Dynamic is a is a time-of-use smart electricity plan, where prices change every half hour. These prices reflect real-time costs in the wholesale Irish electricity market, known as the “Day Ahead Market” or “DAM”.
Instead of paying the same unit price all day, prices vary across the day, and you can choose when to use electricity based on tomorrow’s prices.
The Smart Dynamic tariff is made up of three parts
1. Standing charge
: This is an annual charge and covers the fixed costs associated with providing your gas and electricity supply
2. Base Unit Rate:
A fixed amount for each unit of electricity you use that stays the same all day
3. Dynamic Unit Rate:
A variable amount that changes every half-hour according to the
day-ahead market prices
What are the benefits?
More transparency:
clearly see what you’re paying and when for your electricity use
Potential savings:
if you’re able to shift some electricity usage to lower priced times, you could reduce your bill
Better for the electricity grid and the environment:
using electricity when demand is lower or when more renewable energy is available
Is Smart Dynamic suitable for me?
You need a smart meter
You must have a smart electricity meter installed for this plan, and your smart meter must have a Communications Technically Feasible (CTF) of 4. This means your meter can communicate with ESB Networks every half hour.
You can shift your usage to lower-cost hours
Run high‑energy appliances like dishwashers, washing machines, tumble dryers or EV charging during lower‑cost hours where possible.
You can check prices daily
You’re comfortable checking prices daily so you can plan out your usage.
Check day‑ahead prices using our
daily pricing page
or daily email alerts. Knowing when prices are lower helps you make informed choices.
You’re comfortable with prices going up and down
You’re comfortable with prices going up and down, and don’t need certainty around costs. Smart Dynamic is a financially risky product and, unlike other plans, the dynamic unit rate can move up or down on a half-hourly basis.
You can monitor your costs and usage
You’re happy to regularly track your usage and check your bills on your online account.
Things to consider
If you’re not able to do these things, the Smart Dynamic tariff is may not be the right choice for you.
If you’re a vulnerable customer who is critically dependent on electricity and cannot shift when you use electricity, this tariff is most likely not suitable for you.
Please note that Bord Gáis Energy cannot accept responsibility for any unexpected high costs or bills as a result of this tariff.
How does it work?
Updates
We’ll email you each day with prices for every half hour, from 11pm that night to 11pm tomorrow
Alerts
We’ll send you a second email or an SMS (you choose) if any of the prices exceed your set price alert
Plan
Plan out your usage for the following day to take advantage of the cheaper half hours
View usage
You can view your past daily half-hourly usage and costs in your online account

Below Terms and Conditions are valid for all Dual Fuel offers (EV - Electric Vehicle, Standard and Hive)
With 12 or 24 months Fixed Term contract: discounts are off our electricity and Gas unit rates for 12 months.
After the end of 12 months contract you’ll enjoy 5% discount off electricity only.
You must continue to pay by direct debit and receive paperless bills to continue to receive discounts. (Please note that the Direct Debit payment will be for your full bill amount. If you are an existing Bord Gáis Energy customer and were on Level Pay then this will no longer apply).
An early exit fee of €50 will apply if you leave before the end of your Fixed Term Electricity Contract.
Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026 and gas prices are effective from 1 May 2025. Prices are subject to change.
If you’re signing up for an offer with Hive Active Heating Thermostat, please check these additional
terms and conditions.
Your plan will be powered by 100% renewable electricity and 10% gas will be supplied from renewable sources. For more information,
visit our Renewable page
.
All EV (electric vehicle) offers are not limited to customers who drive an electric vehicle. Please visit our
Electric Vehicle page
.
*All of our electricity plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity, and backed by EU Guarantee of Origin (GO) certificates. For every unit of electricity you use, an equivalent amount of renewable electricity is produced and recorded through the GO system. Subject to verification by the CRU under the CRU’s Green Source Product Verification process.
***Annual savings - for new customers only
.
12 month Dual Fuel Contract. 17% discount off all standard electricity unit rates (exc. Smart Free Time, Smart EV and Dual Fuel Plus Free Hive) and 17% off gas standard unit rates (exc. Dual Fuel Plus Free Hive) for 12 months. A discount of 12% off all standard electricity and gas unit rates applies to Dual Fuel Plus Free Hive.
Terms and Conditions of Duel Fuel Plus Hive
.
You must choose Paperless bills and Direct Debit. Annual Saving for of €506 is compared to our smart All Day Tariff and Gas Standard Tariff (no discount) and annual consumption of 4200 kWh (electricity) and 11,000 kWh (gas). Early exit fee of €50. Electricity prices valid from 9 October 2026, gas prices valid from 1 May 2025 and may vary throughout the contract. See bordgaisenergy.ie for prices, ts and cs and all EABs.
Terms and Conditions of supply
Estimated Annual Bill
* The Estimated Annual Bill is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 11,000 kWh in gas and 4200 kWh in electricity (as defined by the CRU) and Bord Gáis Energy's standard gas tariff and Bord Gáis Energy’s electricity Urban 24 Hour tariff less any percentage discounts. Your actual rates may differ depending on your meter type. Free offers such as boiler services (where applicable) are NOT included. Please refer to
Tariffs&Prices
page for information on EAB and current rates.
Terms & Conditions
Microgen export option is available on plans for qualifying customers who have solar panels installed and have been certified by ESB Networks. Subject to approval.
Variable prices are effective 2 November 2025 and are subject to change. Projected earnings are based on selling electricity to the grid only and don’t include savings from using less electricity. They’re calculated using CRU’s deemed export formula and will vary by your export type, system size, technology, and electricity use.

Below Terms and Conditions are valid for all Electricity offers (EV (Electric Vehicle) and Standard)
With 12 months Fixed Term contract: discounts are off our electricity unit rates for 12 months.
After the end of 12 months contract you’ll enjoy 5% discount off electricity thereafter.
You must continue to pay by direct debit and receive paperless bills to continue to receive discounts. (Please note that the Direct Debit payment will be for your full bill amount. If you are an existing Bord Gáis Energy customer and were on Level Pay then this will no longer apply).
An early exit fee of €50 will apply if you leave before the end of your Fixed Term Electricity Contract.
Prices are effective from 9 October 2026 and are subject to change.
Your plan will be powered by 100% renewable electricity and 10% gas will be supplied from renewable sources. For more information,
visit our Renewable page
.
All EV (electric vehicle) offers are not limited to customers who drive an electric vehicle. Please visit our
Electric Vehicle page
.
*All of our electricity plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity, and backed by EU Guarantee of Origin (GO) certificates. For every unit of electricity you use, an equivalent amount of renewable electricity is produced and recorded through the GO system. Subject to verification by the CRU under the CRU’s Green Source Product Verification process.
***Annual savings - New customers only
Annual saving of
€437
when this offer of 25% off our standard unit rates is compared to Bord Gáis Energy’s standard electricity tariff and using an average annual consumption of 4200 kWh in electricity. Electricity prices valid from 9 October 2026 and may vary throughout the contract. See bordgaisenergy.ie for prices, ts and cs and all EABs.
Terms and Conditions of supply
Estimated Annual Bill
The Estimated Annual Bill is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 4200 kWh in electricity (as defined by the CRU) and Bord Gáis Energy’s Electricity Urban 24 Hour Price Plan less any percentage discounts. Your actual rates may differ depending on your meter type. Free offers such as boiler services (where applicable) are NOT included. Please refer to
Our Tariffs & Prices
page for information on EAB and current rates.
Terms & Conditions
Microgen export option is available on plans for qualifying customers who have solar panels installed and have been certified by ESB Networks. Subject to approval.
Variable prices are effective 2 November 2025 and are subject to change. Projected earnings are based on selling electricity to the grid only and don’t include savings from using less electricity. They’re calculated using CRU’s deemed export formula and will vary by your export type, system size, technology, and electricity use.

Below Terms and Conditions are valid for all Dual Fuel offers (EV - Electric Vehicle, Standard and Hive)
With 12 or 24 months Fixed Term contract: discounts are off our electricity and Gas unit rates for 12 months.
After the end of 12 months contract you’ll enjoy 5% discount off electricity only.
You must continue to pay by direct debit and receive paperless bills to continue to receive discounts. (Please note that the Direct Debit payment will be for your full bill amount. If you are an existing Bord Gáis Energy customer and were on Level Pay then this will no longer apply).
An early exit fee of €50 will apply if you leave before the end of your Fixed Term Electricity Contract.
Electricity prices are effective from 9 October 2026 and gas prices are effective from 1 May 2025. Prices are subject to change.
If you’re signing up for an offer with Hive Active Heating Thermostat, please check these additional
terms and conditions.
Your plan will be powered by 100% renewable electricity and 10% gas will be supplied from renewable sources. For more information,
visit our Renewable page
.
All EV (electric vehicle) offers are not limited to customers who drive an electric vehicle. Please visit our
Electric Vehicle page
.
*All of our electricity plans are powered by 100% renewable electricity, and backed by EU Guarantee of Origin (GO) certificates. For every unit of electricity you use, an equivalent amount of renewable electricity is produced and recorded through the GO system. Subject to verification by the CRU under the CRU’s Green Source Product Verification process.
***Annual savings - for new customers only
.
12 month Dual Fuel Contract. 17% discount off all standard electricity unit rates (exc. Smart Free Time, Smart EV and Dual Fuel Plus Free Hive) and 17% off gas standard unit rates (exc. Dual Fuel Plus Free Hive) for 12 months. A discount of 12% off all standard electricity and gas unit rates applies to Dual Fuel Plus Free Hive.
Terms and Conditions of Duel Fuel Plus Hive
.
You must choose Paperless bills and Direct Debit. Annual Saving for of €506 is compared to our smart All Day Tariff and Gas Standard Tariff (no discount) and annual consumption of 4200 kWh (electricity) and 11,000 kWh (gas). Early exit fee of €50. Electricity prices valid from 9 October 2026, gas prices valid from 1 May 2025 and may vary throughout the contract. See bordgaisenergy.ie for prices, ts and cs and all EABs.
Terms and Conditions of supply
Estimated Annual Bill
* The Estimated Annual Bill is calculated based on an average annual consumption of 11,000 kWh in gas and 4200 kWh in electricity (as defined by the CRU) and Bord Gáis Energy's standard gas tariff and Bord Gáis Energy’s electricity Urban 24 Hour tariff less any percentage discounts. Your actual rates may differ depending on your meter type. Free offers such as boiler services (where applicable) are NOT included. Please refer to
Tariffs&Prices
page for information on EAB and current rates.
Terms & Conditions
Microgen export option is available on plans for qualifying customers who have solar panels installed and have been certified by ESB Networks. Subject to approval.
Variable prices are effective 2 November 2025 and are subject to change. Projected earnings are based on selling electricity to the grid only and don’t include savings from using less electricity. They’re calculated using CRU’s deemed export formula and will vary by your export type, system size, technology, and electricity use.

Home appliance usage
Why choose Bord Gáis Energy for your electricity needs?
Choosing the right energy supplier can make a big difference in your home electricity experience. At Bord Gáis Energy, we offer more than just electricity; we provide smart solutions, cost-saving opportunities, unmissable rewards and exceptional customer service to power your home efficiently.
1. Competitive and transparent pricing
We provide straightforward electricity plans with no hidden costs, helping you manage your energy expenses with ease.
Compare our rates
with other energy suppliers and
find a plan
that suits your household.
2. Exclusive offers and discounts
Our customers enjoy access to exclusive offers, from savings on
home energy upgrades
to discounted electricity rates when
bundled with gas
. Whether you're a new or existing customer, we have tailored deals to help you get the most value.
3. Smart and green energy solutions
Take advantage of energy insights with our
smart plans
, allowing you to optimise your electricity consumption and save money. Plus, with our 100% renewable
green electricity plans
, you can reduce your carbon footprint while enjoying a sustainable energy source.
4. Hassle-free switching
Whether you're with Electric Ireland, SSE Airtricity or any other electricity provider, switching to Bord Gáis Energy is quick and seamless.
Provide your MPRN (found on your electricity bill), a recent meter read, and payment details, and we’ll take care of the rest—no disruption to your electricity connection.
5. Reliable customer support
Our dedicated team is always on hand to assist with your queries, whether you need help understanding your electricity bill, managing your account, or exploring ways to optimise your energy usage.
6. Microgeneration opportunities
Thinking about
solar panels
? With our
microgeneration
scheme, you can generate your own electricity and even sell excess power back to the grid—helping you lower your bills while contributing to a greener future.
Ready to make the switch?
Switching to Bord Gáis Energy is simple and takes just a few minutes. Join thousands of Irish households already benefiting from great rates, smarter energy plans, and dedicated customer service.
Switch now
Frequently asked questions about home electricity
Find answers to the most common queries about your home's electricity usage.
Who do I call if there's an issue with my electricity supply?
ESB Networks
are responsible for connections issues, alterations and loss of supply.
Call ESB Networks on
1800 37 27 57
for connections, alterations or power quality problems or call
1800 37 29 99
for emergencies or a loss of supply.
What is a kWh?
A kilowatt-hour (kWh) is a unit of measurement for electricity usage. It represents the amount of energy consumed when a 1,000-watt (1 kW) appliance runs for one hour.
For example:
A 100-watt light bulb running for 10 hours uses 1 kWh.
A 2,000-watt (2 kW) electric heater running for 30 minutes uses 1 kWh.
Your electricity bill is based on the number of kWh you use each month, along with other charges like the unit charge and standing charge. Reducing your energy consumption—for example, by using energy-efficient appliances or shifting usage to off-peak times—can help lower your electricity costs.
How is a smart electricity plan different to a standard plan?
With a standard plan you pay one unit rate, during peak and off-peak times. With a smart meter, you can choose from a flat rate with the same cost at any hour of the day, or benefit from time-of-use pricing — meaning the rate you pay can vary throughout the day or on the weekend.
By shifting your usage to off-peak hours, you can significantly lower your energy bills.
What are the benefits of a smart meter?
Smart meters automatically send readings, so all bills are based on actual use, not estimates. Easy!
You’ll get loads of useful insights into your energy usage if you then switch to a smart plan. For more information on smart meters, see our
smart meter guide
.
How do day and night rates work?
If you have a Time of Day meter (also called a Day/Night Meter), you’ll be charged different rates during the day and night. During the day, you’ll be charged a higher rate between 8am and 11pm. You’ll be charged a lower rate at night between 11pm and 8am.
You’ll see the two different rates on your bill, listed as ‘day units’ and ‘night units’ in your bill breakdown.
Click here for more information on our different price plans
.
What is the government electricity credit?
A scheme was approved by the government to credit all eligible residential electricity customers with €250, in two €125 (incl. VAT) instalments. This will apply to both bill pay and prepay customers.
The credits were applied to customers' accounts in two payment periods:
the first occurring between 1 November 2024 – 31 December 2024
the second occurring between 1 January 2025 – 28 February 2025
Eligible customers will have had the second credit applied to their account by 9 January 2025.
For more information on the scheme, see on our
help and support
page.
Can I sell back excess electricity to the grid?
If you have solar panels that produce more electricity than you use, you can sell it back to the grid. This scheme is called The Microgeneration Support Scheme. For more information, view our
microgeneration hub
.
How much does an EV add to an electricity bill?
The exact cost depends on your driving needs, car efficiency, and how many miles you drive.
It's more cost effective to drive an EV (electric vehicle) than a fuel-based car. The exact cost depends on your driving needs, car efficiency, and how many miles you drive.
On average, an EV owner charges their EV at home approximately 80% of the time which may add up to 3,000 kWh or more to your electricity bill. If you’re driving your EV 17,500 km per year and sign up to our Smart EV plan, it’ll cost you approximately €180 annually (excluding your household electricity bills), i.e. approximately €1 per 100kms.
Visit
EV price plans
page to learn more.
What is a Discount Weekend smart plan?
Discount Weekend is a Time of Use tariff for customers who already have a smart meter installed. The time-of-use bands are:
Day (8am to 11pm except Peak)
Night (11pm to 8am)
Peak (5pm to 7pm)
Weekends (Friday 11pm to Monday 8am)

online account
.

What is a Smart All Day plan?
If you’re looking for an easy-to-understand smart plan and the same unit rate throughout the day, then the Smart All Day plan may be for you.
This plan splits your usage into four time bands:
Day Monday to Friday (8am to 5pm and 7pm to 9pm)
Day Weekend (8am to 9pm)
Night (9pm to 8am)
Peak (Monday to Friday 5pm to 7pm)
With the Smart All Day plan:
You’ll  have the same flat rate across all time periods
You can choose to be billed monthly or every two months, and pick the day of the month you want to be billed
Your smart meter will collect data every half hour
You'll also be able to view your usage on your online account, and get access to up to 24 months of your historic consumption data via your
online account
.
Terms and conditions for Smart All Day tariffs

What is a Free Time Saturday/Sunday smart plan?
This smart plan offers free electricity on either Saturday or Sunday, you choose.
Select a weekend day and your usage is free from 9am - 5pm (fair usage policy applies).
Free Saturday/Free Sunday is a Time of Use tariff for customers who already have a smart meter installed. The time of use bands are:
Day (8am to 11pm, except Peak)
Night (11pm to 8am)
Peak (5pm to 7pm)
Free Time (9am to 5pm on Saturday or Sunday)
Each time period has its own price for electricity, meaning you can do more at a time that costs less. Free time can be either Saturday or Sunday from 9am to 5pm - you can choose the day that suits you best when you sign up.
Customers will be charged for consumption outside of this time band (9am to 5pm on a Saturday or Sunday) at the times/bands set out above. You can choose if you want to be billed monthly or once every two months, and you can pick the day of the month you want to be billed. Your smart meter data will be collected every half hour.
For more information on smart plans, see our
Smart plans page
.
